description: Requires a PAID Apollo plan (the free plan answers 403). Search Apollo's people database by job title, seniority, and employer domain/org id. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey. Apollo cost: 0 credits — but this endpoint returns an OBFUSCATED last name and never an email or phone number; call apollo_enrich_person on a result to resolve a real contact. Example: apollo_search_people({ titles: ["VP of Sales"], seniorities: ["vp"], domains: ["apollo.io"], _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

seniorities.description: Apollo seniority levels: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern.

titles.description: Job titles to match, e.g. ["VP of Sales", "Head of Growth"]. Matches on contained terms too (e.g. "marketing manager" also matches "content marketing manager").

name: apollo_search_people
title: Apollo Search People
